headline: God’s Word.
On your screen.
bullets: A fresh Bible verse each day
frames.jtbd: I want Scripture close during my ordinary day without remembering to open another app.
frames.scene: Warm linen composition. Familiar upright iPhone Lock Screen with clock and a compact scripture widget; existing Two Sparrows sparrow wallpaper. Enlarged Home Screen widget below shows the same verse. No mood label visible on Lock Screen.

ui.verse: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

frames.visualLimit: Editorial composition of Lock and Home widgets, not a device screenshot. No permanent-free claim; user adds widgets using setup. Verse excerpt is an entire KJV verse.

headline: A Bible verse
for how you feel.
frames.jtbd: When something weighs on me, I want a relevant Bible verse without knowing where to look.
frames.scene: Cream and terracotta enlarged app composition. Anxious, Afraid and Grateful mood buttons, Anxious selected. A real KJV verse with reference, translation selector and Listen action. Warm familiar book typography.

ui.label: When worry won’t let go
ui.verse: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

frames.visualLimit: Enlarged editorial UI assembled from existing mood and verse flows. No diagnosis, healing promise or claim that God personally selected this verse.

headline: End your day
with prayer.
frames.jtbd: At the end of a full day I want an easy way to pause and pray, even when I am tired of reading.
frames.scene: Warm dark Candle composition with the existing nestled sparrows artwork. Enlarged Tonight card with KJV verse, evening prayer label and a clear play control. No sleep score or medical benefit.

ui.label: Tonight
ui.verse: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.

frames.visualLimit: Enlarged editorial Tonight card, not an unchanged simulator screenshot. Audio flow exists in current code; end-to-end live audio not verified in this screenshot task. No timed duration or sleep guarantee.
